hardware: Jetson Orin Nano Super 8GB; L4T36.4.7; CUDA12.6; dynamic clocks, existing desktop/services left running
method: Sequential configurations, reversed CPU/CUDA order in round2. Warm independent workers; independent accuracy checks after all timed workers finish. Percentiles pool raw frame/call samples across both rounds, not averages of percentiles.

scope.pipeline: Detector + POI (mapped scene) + field localization; excludes camera/exposure/USB/MJPEG/preview/NT/robot
scope.joint: Complete Localization.enrich on known synthetic corners; excludes detector/POI/camera/NT
scope.single: Complete native pose API call on known synthetic corners; excludes detector/localization/camera/NT
scope.kernel: Nested CUDA event span; excludes input transfers for joint solve and host/Python work
